scope: Independent visual review of 8 new raster artworks plus actual rendered candidate screenshots, against V0.8.2.2 first-act browser screenshots
candidate_reference: V0.9.4 art over V0.9.2 program; rejected V0.9.3 never used as art standard

observations.identity: Short black-blue hair, bangs, dark jacket, wine-red neckline/strap, facial cool rim and warm practical lights remain recognizable. Dialogue uses a new over-shoulder expression, not the same first-act portrait.
observations.mark_making: Variable black outline, hard shadow masses, rough/halftone-like texture and scratched equipment surfaces align with the first-act comic language; no low-detail geometric placeholders substitute for figures.
narrative: Battery: protagonist reaches for the handle of a physical battery case.
Circuit: close-up of hand connecting red electrical lead to worn equipment.
Lift: protagonist at elevator control, door aperture with warm light and 13 display.
Alarm: deliberate hand press at red alarm panel.
Latch: hands and hooked tool at metal door latch.
Safety door: protagonist pushing door into cold-lit stairwell with spatial depth.
observations.rendering: Corrected CSS renders each narrative at full intended card framing; lift and latch content remain identifiable at 320 and 390. HTML titles and route labels are readable on a lower dark band. Dialogue text is readable without clipping.
observations.workbench: Illustrated investigation props now share the scene palette/material work. Existing schematic network and real control labels remain visible, rather than being replaced by painted controls.

remaining_subjective_review: New scenes use denser wear/grain details than some first-act event cards.
The calibrated portrait remains a newly generated close-up with a different expression and lens/angle; matching the character identity is subject to the user's final art approval.
The dialogue background is not pixel-identical to the pre-calibration candidate; six dedicated narrative event scenes still supply lift/fire-door context.
These observations support an art-review candidate, not a claim that the user has accepted final art quality.

dialogue_calibration.text_clipping: none observed; dimensions match scroll extents
dialogue_calibration.identity_observation: Calibrated smaller angular jaw, closer-fitting short hair, and eye/nose/mouth proportions are visibly nearer to the first-act master than the previous candidate portrait. The earlier round-face/full-hair caveat no longer describes the current asset.
dialogue_calibration.background_observation: The source-image background also changed: the previous explicit elevator 13/warm doorway is no longer clear, replaced by a cool corridor/stairwell and pink wall. Most of this area is behind the HTML dialogue bubble. Do not claim a pixel-identical background.
